static.about.lead: Votix is a ticketing platform that connects organizers and attendees in a straightforward way.
static.about.p1: We provide tools to create event pages, manage ticket types and sales, and give buyers a smooth checkout experience.
static.about.p2: Our goal is to reduce friction—before, during, and after the event—so you can focus on your audience and your programming.
static.about.p3: Whether you run concerts, conferences, workshops, or community gatherings, Votix is built to scale with your needs.
static.help.lead: Find answers quickly or reach out if you need a human.
static.help.p1: These resources cover the most common questions:
static.help.link_faq: frequent questions about buying tickets, accounts, and refunds
static.help.link_contact: message our team for account or billing help
static.help.link_about: learn what Votix offers organizers and attendees
static.help.p2: We usually respond within one to two business days.
static.faq.lead: Answers to questions we hear often.
static.faq.a1: Choose an event, select your tickets, complete checkout, and receive your tickets by email. You can also access them from your account when logged in.
static.faq.a2: Refund rules are set by the event organizer and displayed before purchase. If you are eligible, contact the organizer or our support with your order reference.
static.faq.q3: I did not receive my tickets—what should I do?
static.faq.a3: Check your spam folder first, then verify the email used at checkout. If they are still missing, contact support with your order number.
static.faq.q4: How do I publish an event?
static.faq.a4: Create an organizer account, use the event creation flow to add details and tickets, then publish when you are ready. You can save drafts along the way.
static.faq.a5: Payments are processed through certified payment partners. Votix does not store full card numbers on its servers.
static.contact.lead: We are here to help organizers and ticket buyers.
static.contact.p1: For billing, technical issues, or partnership questions, email us using the address below.
static.contact.p2: Include your order reference or event name so we can assist you faster.
static.sell.lead: Sell tickets online with pages designed for conversion and mobile buyers.
static.sell.p1: As an organizer on Votix you can:
static.sell.li1: Publish rich event pages with schedule, venue, and media
static.sell.li2: Configure free or paid ticket types and inventory
static.sell.li3: Track sales and orders from your dashboard
static.sell.li4: Offer a checkout flow aligned with regional payment options
static.sell.cta_suffix: to create your organizer account and set up your first event.
static.privacy.lead: This policy explains how Votix handles personal data in connection with the platform.
static.privacy.s1_body: We process account details, order and payment-related information needed to deliver ticketing services, and technical logs required to secure the service.
static.privacy.s2_body: We use data to operate the platform, process purchases, communicate about transactions, prevent fraud, and improve reliability and performance.
static.privacy.s3_body: We share data with payment and infrastructure providers only as needed to complete orders and host the service. We do not sell personal data.
static.privacy.s4_body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data where applicable law allows. Contact us using the email shown on the Contact page.
static.terms.lead: By using Votix you agree to these general terms.
static.terms.s1_body: Votix provides an online platform for event discovery and ticket sales. Features may evolve; we aim to maintain reasonable availability.
static.terms.s2_body: You are responsible for the accuracy of information you publish and for complying with laws that apply to your events, including refunds and consumer rules where relevant.
static.terms.s3_body: To the extent permitted by law, the service is provided as-is. Organizers remain responsible for delivering their events; Votix is not the seller of event experiences.
static.terms.s4_body: We may update these terms. Continued use after changes are posted constitutes acceptance unless otherwise required by law.
static.pricing.lead: Transparent pricing that grows with your ticket volume.
static.pricing.p1: Fees depend on your configuration and payment methods. Detailed rates are confirmed in your organizer agreement or onboarding.
static.pricing.p2: There is no charge to create an account or draft events; publishing and selling may be subject to platform or payment fees.
static.pricing.p3: Contact us for a tailored quote if you run large festivals, venues, or recurring series.
